prompt: At 05:30, send tug1 from gate_in to gate_out. Wait up to 90 minutes for 05:30 and, if it has not come by then, stop the job as failed.

paths.when: the task starts at 04:30: it waits 60 minutes, then moves
the task starts at 02:00: 05:30 is more than 90 minutes away, the wait times out

why: Waits are relative durations only; 1.8 has no way to wait for a time of day. 1.9 reads the clock live in `wait until clock_time >= 05:30 timeout 90 min else { ... }` (0042 T5, T6), then the steps. The attempt writes that wait.
